column3: Preserves “after these things” rather than “some time later”.
Preserves the image of lifting his eyes.
Preserves taking the fire and knife “in his hand”, without adding “sacrificial”.
Preserves the verb “see” in the place name and its passive in the saying, rather than using “provide” in both.
Preserves the collective singular “offspring” and the singular “gate”.
Preserves “will bless themselves” rather than the passive “will be blessed”.
